title: Empirical OEV & Liquidation Dynamics: 98.10% Value Recapture in Chainlink SVR Auctions and Structural MEV Power-Law Distribution on Ethereum L1

description:
This open-science replication package and empirical benchmark provides the complete, machine-audited dataset and companion monograph analyzing 1,157 on-chain liquidations across Ethereum L1, Base L2, and Arbitrum during the acute market volatility regime of October 12–19, 2026.

By combining high-frequency sub-second WebSocket telemetry on Base flashblocks with recursive transaction trace decoders, this work presents the first independent empirical proof of Oracle Extractable Value (OEV) recapture under live market stress:

  • 98.10% Protocol Value Recapture: Across 105 verified Chainlink Smart Value Recapture (SVR) liquidations on Base Morpho Blue and Aave v3 totaling $190,506.31 in gross liquidated collateral, competitive solver bidding redirected $186,889.85 USD (98.10%) directly back to protocol reserves and depositors as bids.
  • Bertrand Margin Compression & Winner's Curse: Unconstrained price competition compressed solver gross margins to 1.86% ($3,545.73 USD pre-swap), with median margin settling at -1.55%. In 61.9% of transactions (65/105), solvers concluded at zero or negative net margin prior to off-chain DEX slippage. We document severe overbidding events where solvers bid up to 102.79% of collateral value, absorbing out-of-pocket losses to win transaction inclusion.
  • Decentralization & Absence of Monopolistic Capture: Active participation from 20 distinct solver contract architectures and 27 signing EOAs confirms that order flow auctions maintain genuine Bertrand decentralization without cartelization (top solver volume share capped at 31.64%).
  • Multi-Call Bundling Complexity: 64.76% (68/105) of SVR transactions were atomic multi-calls executing up to 32 liquidation sub-calls in a single transaction. We show that naive single-event indexers miscalculate liquidation volume and solver PnL.
  • Ethereum L1 Power-Law Distribution: Analysis of 1,049 Ethereum L1 liquidations reveals that 80.84% (848 txs) of MEV-Boost block builder priority payments are micro-dust (< $1.00 USD, median $0.08 USD), while the top 22 whale liquidations capture 96.05% ($344,155.62 USD) of all builder revenue via private PBS bundles.

Included Deliverables:
1. Empirical_OEV_and_Liquidation_Dynamics_Research_Monograph.pdf: Camera-ready 3-page research preprint monograph.
2. EMPIRICAL_OEV_AND_LIQUIDATION_RESEARCH_2026.md: Markdown research monograph.
3. data/werracle_oev_empirical_dataset_2026.json: Machine-readable JSON dataset covering 1,157 verified transactions.
4. scripts/verify_dataset_metrics.py: One-command automated Python verification script certifying all 15 core empirical invariants.
5. scripts/audit_multicall_bundle.py: Demonstration script inspecting multi-call bundles and overbid dynamics.
6. data/checksums.sha256: SHA-256 cryptographic verification hashes.
7. Hugging Face Hub: pCwOrM/werracle-oev-liquidation-dataset-2026 (Interactive Table Viewer & load_dataset).

Computing Infrastructure & Sponsorship: Bare-metal dedicated nodes (`pcworm-root`), archival RPC streams, and 24/7 continuous monitoring daemons were provided by Bekirhan Dağlı (Managing Partner) and ITouch Systems Research & Development Desk (Adana Çukurova Teknokent, Türkiye).
